theme.archetype: Luxury Dark + Old Money Tech (Obsidian Gold & AI Indigo)
theme.description: A dark, ultra-premium, approachable financial coaching app. Eliminates banking complexity by explaining money clearly, celebrating milestones with an AI Owl mascot, and guiding users with actionable steps.

typography.font_family_heading: Cabinet Grotesk / Outfit / Plus Jakarta Sans, sans-serif

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.caption: text-xs font-medium tracking-wide text-slate-500 uppercase

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/70 border border-white/10 shadow-2xl shadow-black/50

owl_mascot.name: Athena the Wise Owl
owl_mascot.badge: bg-indigo-500/10 text-indigo-400 border border-indigo-500/20 rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5
owl_mascot.quote_box: bg-indigo-950/40 border border-indigo-500/30 rounded-2xl p-4 text-indigo-200 shadow-lg relative overflow-hidden

visual_enhancers.score_gauge: Simple 1-100 Wealth Health Score with status indicator (e.g. 78/100 'Thriving')
visual_enhancers.card_style: rounded-2xl border border-white/10 bg-slate-900/60 p-5 md:p-6 backdrop-blur-md

layout_and_navigation.responsive_strategy: Mobile bottom navigation bar with key quick actions + Desktop full left sidebar (collapsible/fixed)
layout_and_navigation.header: Fixed top bar with quick Financial Health Badge (Score 78), Owl Mascot Quick Coach toggle, Notifications trigger, and Profile avatar with backdrop-blur-md bg-slate-950/80 z-40 border-b border-white/10
layout_and_navigation.grid_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a unified single-page responsive React application with a slick, intuitive navigation bar / sidebar allowing seamless switching across all 22 required pages/views.
Implement the dark luxury coach aesthetic with smooth framer-motion tab transitions and custom micro-interactions.
Ensure the Owl Mascot (Athena) appears as a floating assistant widget and sticky coach highlight across views.
Use mock interactive states (adding goals, asking AI coach questions with simulated smart responses, calculating budget changes, toggling accounts).
Add data-testid to all interactive components (buttons, tabs, inputs, cards) for end-to-end testing reliability.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or plain white backgrounds. Always maintain dark obsidian depth.
Use lucide-react icons exclusively for clean vector rendering.
Ensure all contrast ratios exceed WCAG AA standards in dark mode.
Always set explicit text color on hover states (e.g. hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white).
Add data-testid attributes to all primary buttons, inputs, links, and cards.
